notes.title: Demo Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow Bug-ddies!

Since the demo of "Moth Kubit" has gone live, we've received a lot of love and support from our bug-ddies. We appreciate all the hard work you've put into corporation.

However, we've also received some anonymous complaints about our workflow, and we can't accept that at the mega-corporation known for efficiency and rigor!

So we've gathered over a hundred departments and fixed them before the end of the world arrives!

Here's what the first patch update includes:


 Fixed crashing after the some small games timer ends.
 Fixed some room doors not showing interactive icons.
 Fixed the positioning problem of some interactive room doors.
 Fixed some display errors.
 All small games now have button prompts.
 Added transitions between rooms.
 Added sound effects to some small games.

We've brought a more comfortable working environment and we'll continue this tradition.

Thanks to all our bug-ddies out there!

Development Team 
May 25, 2023
